responsibility: Contains the RTL machine description for LM32: the instruction patterns, expanders, attributes, and scheduler reservations that map GCC RTL operations onto concrete LM32 instructions. It defines mov, arithmetic, shift, branch, PIC-relocation, prologue/epilogue, nop, and blockage patterns; instruction lengths and functional-unit timing; and uses predicates and constraints from the companion .md files to control matching and alternatives. This file is the main declarative instruction-selection and scheduling specification for the backend.
same_name_distinction: Holds the generated machine-description side of the LM32 port: RTL define_expand/define_insn patterns, attributes, and pipeline reservations that select and schedule concrete instructions such as moves, shifts, PIC materialization, prologue/epilogue expansion hooks, nop, and blockage. This differs from lm32.cc’s C++ hook logic, lm32.h’s target macros, and lm32.opt’s option declarations.
